newsitem.title: LATVIA: KAIJA Q1 NET PROFIT 80,980 LATS.
newsitem.headline: KAIJA Q1 NET PROFIT 80,980 LATS.

text.p: Latvian fish cannery company Kaija said on Wednesday that its profit in the first quarter of 1997 was 80,980 lats on net turnover of 2.7 million lats.
The company said in a statement that its gross profit in the first quarter was 271,222 lats after production expenses of 2.43 million lats.
The company, part of the Ave Lat group, also said that sales expenses were 25,524 lats and that its administrative expenses were 124,033 lats.
Other income from operations was 22,776 lats and profit before tax and extraordinary items was 118,758 lats while the extraordinary profit before tax was 15,542 lats.
The company also said it paid tax of 53,320 lats.
